Asha (CS): Heads-up — kickoff for Polaris Dedicated pool commissioning in 2h. Need final signoff on quota plan + autoscale knobs before we start the smoke load.
Lina (AE): On my side quota approved by finance. AE -> CS handoff done. I can join the call. :thumbsup:
Jules (CS): Thanks. Two items: 1) confirm target p95 latency <= 150ms for text-gen route; 2) make sure prefix caching enabled for steady-state tests.
Marek (SRE): p95 target noted. We're planning auto-scale policy: min_nodes=2, max_nodes=12, scale_up_rate=+2 per 30s, cool_down=90s. Will cap CPU burst at 85%. Posting current policy:
```
policy: autoscale_dedicated
min:2
max:12
metric: tokens_per_second
scale_step:2
interval:30s
```
Samir (Solutions): For the load script use ramp: 0 -> 500 rps over 12m, hold 15m, then spike to 1200 rps for 3m. Use realistic prompt mix: 60% short (<128 tokens), 30% mid (128-512), 10% long (>512). I'll attach the jmx afterwards.
deploy-bot: loadtest-runner: started job 2026-03-23T14:10Z (job id ltr-8792)
Asha (CS): Risk note: if we see sustained p95>200ms during prime gap we'll flag renewal risk in the account notes and pause rollout. Need QA on fallback routing to smaller model variant.
Marek (SRE): Verified fallback route exists: redwood-route -> model-v2-small. Auto-fallback trigger: queueing_latency>250ms for 30s.
Jules (CS): Capture enablement tasks: runbook link https://internal.redwood/docs/polaris-dedicated-runbook, ops checklist, and customer training slot at 03/26. I'll log items in the account health doc.
Lina (AE): Customer wants a dry-run replay of night traffic too — can we schedule 02:00 UTC shadow run?
Samir (Solutions): Yes, shadow run scheduled. I'll push a separate job: replay-night-traffic-03-24. Adding KV-prefetch toggle to test matrix.
Marek (SRE): Quick note: during last dry-run we hit OOM on model-v2-large at 1024 seq on a 48GB GPU. Adding a memory guard: reject >900 seq to that variant.
Asha (CS): OK all — final checklist: reply with :thumbsup: once you have the load script, runbook entry, and autoscale policy committed. We'll start smoke at T+30m.
Lina (AE): :thumbsup:
Samir (Solutions): :thumbsup: upload jmx in 10m
Marek (SRE): :thumbsup: policy committed
Jules (CS): :thumbsup: runbook updated
